observer: Claude (Opus 5.5), 9 Nov 2026: the raw scan blurred 3x3, read at a 0.05 grid whole and in crops at 0.02 (0.01 where stated), floor pass; the old cabin's flat plate was not used as a reference
covers: the operators' folded seats on the left wall looking down and aft along the wall: the seat frames on their floor brackets, the floor beside them, a flat olive pad, the white plate at the aft end, the plugs of the 0096-9M
notes: Vehicle: the hangar session, ex-NVA 9A33BM3-1 (catalogue g082-g096); nothing in this photo suggests another vehicle. The catalogue says looking forward-left, but the 0096-9M's silver-bound plugs at top left and the same white plate and tan strap as g093-c's top right put the far end aft; with the rack at image right this is the left wall looking aft. The bench and its seats are on the vehicle's left. The seat frames stand on a stepped sheet base at the lower right (0.3-0.45, 0.8-1.0), the g093-c left step. The flat olive pad at the lower left is matt, not the shiny seat leatherette; what it is I could not settle.
